title_zh: 币安计划动用一半SAFU基金以弥补安全事件损失
title_en: Binance Plans to Draw Half of SAFU Fund for Breach Losses
summary_zh:
据TOKENPOST报道，币安计划动用其“用户安全资产基金”（SAFU）中约一半的资金，用于弥补一次安全事件造成的损失。若付诸实施，这将是迄今规模最大的交易所保险储备动用案例之一。

SAFU是币安用于用户赔付的最后一道防线，因此如此规模的动用意味着此次事件的损失相对于交易所为此专门预留的储备而言规模较大。

SAFU成立于2018年7月，资金来源为币安按一定比例划拨的交易手续费；币安学院称，截至2026年该基金持有的加密资产价值约10亿美元，且该数值会随市场波动。
summary_en:
Binance intends to draw down approximately half of its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) to cover losses stemming from a breach, according to a TOKENPOST report. If carried out, it would be one of the largest deployments of an exchange insurance reserve to date.

SAFU is Binance's last-resort user compensation pool, so a draw of this size signals that the incident's losses are large relative to the reserve the exchange maintains for exactly this purpose.

SAFU was set up in July 2018 and is funded by allocating a percentage of Binance's trading fees; Binance Academy describes the fund as holding crypto assets valued at roughly US$1 billion as of 2026, a figure that fluctuates with the market.

title_zh: THORChain 跨链兑换在报告出现退款错误后于 12 条链上持续暂停
title_en: THORChain Swaps Remain Paused on 12 Chains After Reported Refund Error
summary_zh:
在报告出现退款机制错误后，THORChain 的跨链兑换功能在 12 条支持的链上仍处于暂停状态。据 Chainalysis 称，10 月 31 日上午（美国东部时间）以太坊发生的一次链重组，导致 THORChain 错误地向一名存入 10 ETH 的用户进行了双重退款，从而触发了紧急暂停。

此次暂停使所有用户在 THORChain 的大部分桥上无法进行跨链兑换。Chainalysis 表示，这一暂停也意外延缓了一笔从 Binance 窃取的大额资金的洗钱活动。

Chainalysis 将触发原因具体归结为以太坊链重组，即此前已被接受的区块被竞争链上的区块所取代的事件。在现有材料中，尚未确认该事件造成的损失金额。
summary_en:
THORChain's cross-chain swap functionality remains suspended across 12 supported chains following a reported error in its refund mechanism. According to Chainalysis, an Ethereum chain reorganization on the morning of October 31 (EDT) caused THORChain to mistakenly issue a double refund to a user who had deposited 10 ETH, prompting an emergency pause.

The pause blocks cross-chain swaps for all users across most of THORChain's bridges. Chainalysis said the halt also inadvertently delayed the laundering of a significant amount of funds stolen from Binance.

Chainalysis attributed the trigger specifically to an Ethereum chain reorganization, a event in which previously accepted blocks are replaced by a competing chain. No loss figures for the incident have been confirmed in the supplied material.

title_zh: Threshold 暂停 tBTC 铸造与赎回后，Aave 冻结其 tBTC 储备
title_en: Aave Freezes tBTC Reserve After Threshold Pauses Minting and Redemptions
summary_zh:
Threshold 暂停了其封装比特币资产 tBTC 的铸造与赎回，Aave 随后冻结了 tBTC 储备，作为防范坏账与抵押品风险的一项预防性措施。此次暂停涉及的封装比特币资产已被多个 DeFi 平台集成，其中包括 Aave 的借贷市场。

Aave 的举措使这一中断在其 tBTC 被使用的主要借贷平台上直接显现，因为冻结储备属于针对单一资产的风险处置，而非例行的参数调整。Threshold 暂停所造成的损失目前尚未量化。

在 Aave 上，冻结储备会关闭单一市场的新增存款与借款操作，但保留还款与提现功能，因此现有 tBTC 头寸在流动性允许的情况下仍可退出。Threshold 的跨链桥依赖一组使用门限密码学的去中心化节点运营商来完成 tBTC 的铸造与赎回。
summary_en:
Threshold paused minting and redemptions of tBTC, its wrapped-Bitcoin asset, and Aave responded by freezing its tBTC reserve as a precautionary measure against bad debt and collateral risk. The halt affects a wrapped-Bitcoin asset that is integrated across multiple DeFi venues, including Aave's lending market.

Aave's action makes the disruption visible on the largest lending venue where tBTC is used, since a reserve freeze is an asset-specific risk action rather than a routine parameter adjustment. Losses from the Threshold halt have not been quantified.

On Aave, a reserve freeze disables new supply and borrow operations for a single market while leaving repayments and withdrawals active, so existing tBTC positions can still be unwound subject to liquidity. Threshold's bridge relies on a decentralized set of node operators using threshold cryptography to mint and redeem tBTC.

title_zh: OpenAI融资目标骤降100亿美元，估值同步下调至1.25万亿美元
title_en: OpenAI's funding target drops by $10 billion, valuation cut to $1.25 trillion in tandem
summary_zh:
据英国《金融时报》报道，OpenAI 将最新一轮融资的目标规模下调 100 亿美元，目前寻求以 1.25 万亿美元估值融资约 200 亿美元，低于此前以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元的计划。投资者认购截止日期为上周五，知情人士称由于部分投资者下调了认购额度，预计首轮交割（first close）的融资额将低于 200 亿美元的目标。

据《金融时报》描述，这家全球最受关注的 AI 实验室下调融资预期，表明投资者正在削减对 AI 估值的投入，而此时公开市场的 AI 相关股票正遭遇抛售。

OpenAI 此前以 7 月以来营收快速增长为由，为其 1.4 万亿美元估值提供依据——这一估值较此前的 8520 亿美元接近翻倍，并将该轮融资宣传为投资者在明年 IPO 前最后一次入股的机会。《金融时报》报道称，首轮交割的融资额将低于 200 亿美元的目标。
summary_en:
OpenAI has cut the target size of its latest funding round by $10 billion and is now seeking roughly $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, down from an earlier plan of $30 billion at $1.4 trillion, according to the Financial Times. The investor subscription deadline was last Friday, and people familiar said the first close is expected to come in below the $20 billion target because some investors have reduced their commitments.

The downward revision at the world's most closely watched AI lab indicates investors are trimming commitments to AI valuations, as described by the FT, at a time when listed AI-related stocks are being sold off.

OpenAI had justified the earlier valuation of $1.4 trillion — nearly double a prior $852 billion mark — by pointing to rapid revenue growth since July, and had pitched the round as investors' last chance to buy in before a planned IPO next year. The FT report says the first close will fall short of the $20 billion target.

title_zh: Jepsen：ParticleDB 1.1.4
title_en: Jepsen: ParticleDB 1.1.4
summary_zh:
Jepsen 发布了对 ParticleDB 的分析报告。ParticleDB 是一款面向 AI 工作负载的多模型数据库，Jepsen 测试了 1.1.4 至 1.1.18.11.rc-22 的多个版本，认定其“完整 ACID”的宣称并不成立。报告记录了已提交写入丢失、内部一致性违规，以及 G1a（读到已中止事务）、G1b（读到中间状态）和 P4（更新丢失）等异常，并称共向该项目提交了 96 个问题。

Jepsen 明确建议用户停止继续部署 ParticleDB，并尽快迁移到其他数据库；同时建议在可能的情况下，从更可靠的数据源核对或重建数据库状态。

Jepsen 表示，ParticleDB 官网曾宣称该系统已通过 TLA+ 获得“形式化证明”，但在双方合作期间并未提供任何 TLA+ 规范，因此无法确定究竟证明了哪些性质，也无法确定这些性质描述的是否是实际构建出的 ParticleDB。报告还列举了其宣称的 Postgres 兼容性失效的具体表现，包括部分不可见且无法删除的行、被删除的表以扭曲形态重新出现、列错乱以及字符串变成整数等。
summary_en:
Jepsen published an analysis of ParticleDB, a multi-model database marketed for AI workloads, testing versions 1.1.4 through 1.1.18.11.rc-22 and finding that its "Full ACID" claims did not hold. The report documents loss of committed writes, internal consistency violations, G1a (aborted read), G1b (intermediate read) and P4 (lost update) anomalies, and states that Jepsen filed 96 issues against the system.

Jepsen explicitly recommended that users halt further deployment of ParticleDB and migrate to other databases as soon as possible, and suggested checking or rebuilding database state from more reliable sources where possible.

Jepsen said ParticleDB's home page advertised the system as "formally proven" with a TLA+ proof, but that no TLA+ specification was available during the collaboration, leaving it unclear which properties were proven or whether they described ParticleDB as built. The report also lists failures of the claimed Postgres compatibility, including partially invisible rows that could not be deleted, dropped tables re-emerging in distorted forms, confused columns and strings turning into integers.

title_zh: Chainalysis 证实发生安全漏洞，客户信息遭泄露
title_en: Chainalysis Confirms Security Breach, Customer Details Exposed
summary_zh:
据 CryptoRank 报道，Chainalysis 已证实发生一起安全漏洞事件，导致客户信息被泄露。这使得这家区块链分析与合规服务供应商成为加密行业中又一家承认客户信息遭泄露的第三方服务商。

Chainalysis 为交易所、金融机构和政府机构提供交易追踪与合规工具，因此其客户信息泄露会给这些客户带来数据保护与交易对手风险方面的疑问。

报道称，此次事件的影响限于客户信息，并未涉及资金损失，已确认的泄露数据范围被描述为有限。
summary_en:
Chainalysis has confirmed a security breach in which customer details were exposed, CryptoRank reported. The disclosure makes the blockchain-analytics and compliance vendor the latest third-party provider in the crypto industry to acknowledge a compromise of client information.

Chainalysis supplies transaction-tracing and compliance tooling to exchanges, financial institutions and government agencies, so exposure of its customer details raises data-protection and counterparty-risk questions for those clients.

The report describes the impact as confined to customer details rather than any loss of funds, with the confirmed scope of exposed data described as limited.

title_zh: 自己算算：我们是如何接管 ChatGPT 账户的
title_en: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts
summary_zh:
安全研究团队 Parameter 披露了一条针对 ChatGPT 的账户接管攻击链，利用了产品的 Preview 内容以及多层前端防御机制。OpenAI 确认两个前端均拦截了报告中所述的消息，已于 10 月 26 日以 P1 级严重性修复该问题，并支付了总额 5000 美元的赏金。

ChatGPT 中被确认的账户接管路径意味着，受害者只需点击一个分享链接，攻击代码就可能在其已登录的会话中执行，从而暴露会话列表和私密内容。不过该攻击链需要用户交互，目前也没有在野利用的报告。

根据研究人员的说法，Preview 沙箱本身并未被突破——在其中渲染的代码无法读取主页面——绕过实际发生在 postMessage、CSP 和 JSONP 等其它环节。所披露的攻击链依赖受害者点击公开的分享链接。
summary_en:
Security researchers at Parameter disclosed a ChatGPT account-takeover chain that abused the product's Preview content and layered frontend defenses. OpenAI confirmed that both frontends rejected the reported messages, resolved the issue on October 26 as a P1-severity bug, and awarded a total bounty of $5,000.

A confirmed account-takeover path in ChatGPT means a single clicked share link could run code inside a victim's authenticated session, exposing conversation lists and private content. The chain required user interaction and no in-the-wild exploitation has been reported.

According to the researchers' account, the Preview sandbox itself held — code rendered there could not read the main page — and the bypass instead worked through other layers such as postMessage, CSP and JSONP gadgets. The disclosed chain depended on the victim clicking a public share link.

title_zh: Kintsu官网已恢复，但团队仍提醒暂勿连接钱包
title_en: Kintsu Website Restored, but Team Still Warns Users Not to Connect Wallets
summary_zh:
基于 Monad 区块链的流动性质押协议 Kintsu 于 10 月 31 日表示，其官网 kintsu.xyz 已恢复正常并重新指向项目方自有基础设施。团队提醒用户，在 DNS 缓存完全刷新、官方发布安全确认之前，继续避免访问该网站并不要连接钱包，并称部分网络在未来一小时内仍可能访问到恶意网站。

最先披露此次正在进行的前端攻击的安全机构 Blockaid 建议用户暂时不要使用受影响的去中心化应用，并表示正在调查。Kintsu 的提醒说明，即便域名已恢复，风险也尚未完全解除，因为 DNS 传播延迟仍可能让部分用户访问到恶意版本。

据 Blockaid 称，受影响网站被植入恶意脚本，用户点击"Connect Wallet"（连接钱包）后可能被重定向至恶意的资产转移页面。Blockaid 表示该攻击与 StepDrainer 工具包有关，涉及 kintsu、flap 和 stonkbrokers 三个网站。
summary_en:
Kintsu, a liquid staking protocol on the Monad blockchain, said on October 31 that its official website kintsu.xyz has been restored and again points to the project's own infrastructure. The team warned users to keep avoiding the site and not to connect wallets until DNS caches fully refresh and it issues an official security confirmation, noting that some networks may still reach the malicious site for up to an hour.

Security firm Blockaid, which flagged the ongoing front-end attack, advised users not to use the affected decentralized applications while it investigates. Kintsu's warning indicates the risk is not fully cleared even after the domain was restored, because DNS propagation delays can keep serving the malicious version.

According to Blockaid, malicious scripts were injected into the affected sites so that users who clicked "Connect Wallet" could be redirected to a page designed to move their assets. Blockaid said the attack was linked to the StepDrainer toolkit and involved three sites: kintsu, flap and stonkbrokers.

title_zh: ICE 重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，强调“计划引入”与“有待监管批准”
title_en: ICE Reposts Trade[XYZ] Partnership Announcement, Emphasizing "Plans to Bring" an
summary_zh:
洲际交易所（ICE）在删除早前发布的贴文后重新发布了与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改了措辞，称双方“计划将基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国”，而任何“美国受监管版本”仍严格“有待监管批准”。更新后的公告称，双方正在申请批准以推出一个基于 Hyperliquid 的新市场，用于运营符合 KYC 要求的永续合约市场，其中包括支持杠杆交易所需的批准。

修改后的措辞表明该安排尚未获批：基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约市场尚无确认推出的美国受监管版本，而杠杆交易还需要单独的监管批准。

原公告在修改后重新发布之前已被撤下，新文本一致将该美国市场表述为“计划中”而非“已获批”。申请范围既包括市场本身，也单独包括杠杆交易。
summary_en:
After deleting its earlier post, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) republished its partnership announcement with Trade[XYZ] with amended wording, stating the two parties "plan to bring Hyperliquid-based perps to the U.S." and that any "U.S. regulated versions" remain strictly "subject to regulatory approvals." The revised post says both parties are seeking approvals to launch a new Hyperliquid-based market for KYC-compliant perpetual futures, including approvals needed to support leveraged trading.

The amended language shows the arrangement has not been approved: no U.S. regulated version of the Hyperliquid-based perpetuals market is confirmed to launch, and leveraged trading would require separate regulatory sign-off.

The original announcement was taken down before being reposted in revised form, and the new text consistently frames the U.S. venue as planned rather than approved. Approval is being sought both for the market itself and specifically for leveraged trading.

title_zh: 【OnePay 支持 USDC 直接转入支票账户余额】
title_en: OnePay Now Supports Direct USDC Transfers Into Checking-Account Balance
summary_zh:
沃尔玛旗下金融科技应用 OnePay 宣布，用户现在可以将 USDC 稳定币直接发送至 OnePay 账户，资金会自动进入其现有的支票账户余额，用于支付账单和转账，无需再经过交易所转换。

该功能省去了交易所兑换环节，使这一锚定美元的稳定币持有者可以直接在沃尔玛支持的消费级应用内将资金用于账单支付和转账。

OnePay 表示，相关银行服务由 Coastal Community Bank 或 Lead Bank 提供。
summary_en:
Walmart-backed fintech app OnePay announced that users can now send USDC stablecoins directly to their OnePay account, with the funds automatically credited to their existing checking-account balance for bill payments and transfers, without going through an exchange conversion.

The feature removes the exchange-conversion step, letting holders of the dollar-pegged stablecoin apply funds directly to bill payments and transfers inside a Walmart-backed consumer app.

OnePay said the related banking services are provided by Coastal Community Bank or Lead Bank.

title_zh: 【多个 Web3 项目网站遭到 DNS 劫持攻击】
title_en: Websites of several Web3 projects hit by DNS hijacking attack
summary_zh:
Blockaid 在 X 上发推称，检测到包括 Flap、Stonk 等在内的多个 Web3 项目网站遭到 DNS 劫持攻击，用户访问时会被重定向到黑客设置的、包含恶意软件的页面。

通过被劫持的域名访问这些项目前端的用户，可能被导向攻击者控制的页面而非真实网站，从而面临恶意软件风险，而无法与原本的应用进行交互。

Blockaid 描述的这起事件影响的是项目网站的 DNS 解析环节，而非链上合约；该推文未说明受影响项目的具体数量或受影响用户规模。
summary_en:
Blockaid said in a post on X that it detected DNS hijacking attacks on the websites of several Web3 projects, including Flap and Stonk, so that visitors are redirected to hacker-controlled pages containing malware.

Anyone who reached these project front-ends through the hijacked domains could be routed to attacker infrastructure rather than the genuine site, exposing visitors to malware rather than interacting with the intended application.

The compromise described by Blockaid affects the DNS resolution of the projects' websites rather than their on-chain contracts, and Blockaid did not state in the post how many projects or how many users were affected.

title_zh: 刚刚，DeepSeek重磅开源：Agent底座架构！
title_en: Just now, DeepSeek made a major open-source release: the Agent base architecture!
summary_zh:
据量子位报道，DeepSeek 将其 Agent 底座架构开源，报道以“AI 已经自己找到 Bug 并提交 PR”作为核心看点。搜索结果显示，此次开源的对象是 DeepSeek Harness，即一套开源的 Agent 运行时，而不是新的模型。

头部模型厂商开源 Agent 运行时，意味着开发者可以直接在可自托管的底座上构建编码智能体，而不必自行拼装这套脚手架，也不必依赖厂商的托管产品。

对这套 Harness 的介绍称，它基于 Cordis 的“一切皆插件”架构，提供会话、工具、工作区、沙箱、插件、Agent 循环以及网页与终端界面；被标注为实验性的功能包括 Agent 团队、自动审批审核和定时任务。量子位的报道本身除“自主找 Bug 并提交 PR”之外，技术细节较少。
summary_en:
DeepSeek has open-sourced its Agent base architecture, according to QbitAI, which framed the release around AI agents that can autonomously locate bugs and submit pull requests. Search descriptions identify the released component as DeepSeek Harness, an open-source agent runtime rather than a new model.

An open-source agent runtime from a major model lab gives developers a self-hostable base for building coding agents instead of assembling that scaffolding themselves or depending on a vendor's hosted product.

Descriptions of the harness say it is built on Cordis's “everything is a plugin” architecture and provides sessions, tools, workspaces, sandboxing, plugins, agent loops, plus web and terminal interfaces; experimental items listed include agent teams, auto approval review and scheduled tasks. The QbitAI item itself carries little technical detail beyond the autonomous bug-finding and PR-submission claim.

title_zh: 私人信贷基金欠银行3490亿美元，而这些基金可能并未从借款人处收回现金
title_en: Banks are owed $349B by private credit funds that may not be collecting cash from borrowers
summary_zh:
CryptoSlate报道称，私人信贷基金欠银行约3490亿美元，而这些基金可能并未从借款人处实际收取现金。报道将该敞口描述为信用风险来源，而非已确认的损失事件。

报道称，考虑到银行融资与私人信贷放贷之间的相互关联，这一敞口引发了对信用风险及更广泛市场蔓延的担忧。

该说法呈现的是被报道的敞口规模，而非已确认的违约或已实现损失。核心担忧在于借款人是否以现金偿付，而非仅累积债务。
summary_en:
CryptoSlate reported that banks are owed roughly $349 billion by private credit funds, which may not be collecting cash from their borrowers. The report frames the exposure as a source of credit risk rather than a confirmed loss event.

The report says the exposure raises concerns about credit risk and broader market contagion, given how bank financing and private credit lending are interlinked.

The claim is presented as a reported exposure figure, not as a confirmed default or realized loss. The concern centers on whether borrowers are paying cash, rather than accruing obligations.

title_zh: BTCPay Server 在热钱包被扫空报告后敦促用户关闭实例
title_en: BTCPay Server Urges Shutdown After Reports of Hot-Wallet Sweeps
summary_zh:
开源自托管的比特币支付处理器 BTCPay Server 在出现其相关热钱包被“扫空”的报告后，建议运营者关闭自己的实例，表明这是一起正在发生的、影响比特币商户的安全事件。该项目的指引还要求运营者升级至 2.4.2 版本，该版本会一并更新 LND 并重新生成其 admin macaroon。

自行运行 BTCPay 实例的商户掌握着服务器所控制资金的私钥，因此在资金被持续盗取的情况下，在关闭或升级之前他们将直接面临损失风险。BTCPay 是托管式支付处理器之外被广泛采用的自托管方案，这使得该警告涉及的运营范围异常广泛。

该事件似乎与 2.4.2 之前版本中的一个闪电网络凭证漏洞有关，攻击者可借此获取控制商店闪电网络资金的凭证。该项目表示，若运营者不确定升级是否已正确生效，应通过用户界面或 btcpay-update.sh 重新执行更新；目前报道中尚未厘清具体损失规模与根本原因。
summary_en:
BTCPay Server, the open-source self-hosted Bitcoin payment processor, advised operators to shut down their instances after reports that hot wallets tied to the software were being swept, indicating an active security incident affecting Bitcoin merchants. The project's guidance also directed operators to update to version 2.4.2, which refreshes LND and regenerates its admin macaroon.

Merchants running their own BTCPay instances hold the keys to the funds those servers control, so an active draining incident exposes them to direct loss until they shut down or update. BTCPay is a widely used self-hosted alternative to custodial payment processors, giving the advisory an unusually large operational footprint.

The incident appears tied to a Lightning credential flaw in versions before 2.4.2 that let attackers obtain the credentials controlling a store's Lightning funds. The project said operators unsure whether an update applied correctly should re-run it via the user interface or btcpay-update.sh; the exact loss magnitude and root cause have not been resolved in reporting.

title_zh: 币安遭黑客攻击引发数字资产安全疑问，网络安全股受关注
title_en: Cybersecurity Stocks In Focus After Binance Hack Raises Digital Asset Security Questions
summary_zh:
Simply Wall St 发布市场评论，指出在币安遭遇黑客攻击、重新引发对数字资产安全与交易所防护措施的担忧后，网络安全类股票成为关注焦点。该文属于二级市场评论而非第一手事件报道，未明确损失规模或受影响用户数量。

该文把交易所安全事件与投资者对上市网络安全厂商的关注联系起来，将加密事件风险视为该板块潜在的需求驱动因素。

搜索结果中出现的其他报道将 2026 年币安被攻击事件描述为史上最大规模的加密货币盗窃案，规模超过 2025 年 Bybit 的 15 亿美元黑客事件，并称投资者已撤出 36 亿美元资金；这些数据来自其他媒体，并非 Simply Wall St 评论的内容。
summary_en:
Simply Wall St published a market commentary item flagging cybersecurity stocks as a focus of attention after a hack at Binance renewed concerns about digital-asset security and exchange safeguards. The piece is secondary stock-market commentary rather than primary incident reporting, and it does not establish the size of the loss or the number of users affected.

The item links an exchange security failure to investor attention on listed cybersecurity vendors, framing crypto-incident risk as a potential demand driver for that sector.

Other reporting surfaced in search results describes a 2026 Binance breach as the largest-ever cryptocurrency heist, surpassing the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, with investors withdrawing $3.6 billion in funds; those figures come from separate outlets and are not part of the Simply Wall St commentary.

title_zh: 【b14g 遭未经授权提取 9700 万枚 CORE，已暂停合约并冻结部分资金】
title_en: b14g Suffers Unauthorized Withdrawal of 97 Million CORE, Pauses Contracts and Freezes Some Funds
summary_zh:
比特币双质押层 b14g 表示，北京时间 10 月 31 日 17:29，约 9700 万枚通过 b14g 质押的 CORE 被未经授权提取并转入攻击者地址。该协议称已在发现后立即暂停受影响合约，并正与 Core 团队、安全伙伴及交易所合作追踪资金、协调冻结与恢复。

Core DAO 表示，影响 b14g 的漏洞不影响 Core 网络本身，共识、验证者及质押合约全程正常运行，直接与验证者质押或通过其他协议质押的 CORE 不受影响。追踪显示约 6800 万枚 CORE 仍留在 Core 链上，交易所已冻结约 900 万枚与该事件相关的 CORE。

CryptoSlate 报道称，攻击者利用了“零代币提取”方式从该比特币质押平台转走 CORE。资金追回仍在进行中：交易所冻结的约 900 万枚 CORE 只是部分金额，大部分资金仍留在链上而未被追回。
summary_en:
b14g, a Bitcoin dual-staking layer, said that at 17:29 Beijing time on October 31, roughly 97 million CORE tokens staked through its protocol were withdrawn without authorization and transferred to an attacker's address. The protocol said it immediately paused the affected contracts and is working with the Core team, security partners and exchanges to trace the funds and coordinate freezes and recovery.

Core DAO said the vulnerability affecting b14g does not affect the Core network itself: consensus, validators and staking contracts ran normally throughout, and CORE staked directly with validators or through other protocols is unaffected. Tracking shows about 68 million CORE is still on the Core chain, with exchanges having frozen roughly 9 million CORE tied to the incident.

CryptoSlate reported that "zero-token withdrawals" allowed the attacker to drain the CORE from the Bitcoin staking platform. Recovery is still in progress: the roughly 9 million CORE frozen by exchanges is a partial amount, and the majority of the funds remains on-chain rather than recovered.

title_zh: SOON生态两座跨链桥出现异常提款，官方已暂停服务并展开调查
title_en: Two cross-chain bridges in the SOON ecosystem see abnormal withdrawals; officials suspend service and open investigation
summary_zh:
SOON Foundation 表示，2026 年 10 月 31 日约 11:00（UTC），svmBNB 与 SOON 主网两座跨链桥出现异常提款活动。基金会在当日 14:00（UTC）发现异常后立即关闭桥接服务，并称目前已控制相关跨链桥，调查完成前两座桥将持续暂停运行。

在调查期间，svmBNB 与 SOON 主网之间的跨链通道被冻结，用户暂时无法通过这两条路径桥接资产。

公告未披露异常提款涉及的资产规模及具体损失。SOON 表示将根据调查进展公布更多信息。
summary_en:
SOON Foundation said that at roughly 11:00 UTC on 31 October 2026, abnormal withdrawal activity occurred on the svmBNB and SOON Mainnet cross-chain bridges. The foundation detected the anomaly at 14:00 UTC that day and immediately shut down the bridging services, saying both bridges remain under its control and will stay offline pending an investigation.

The halt freezes cross-chain movement between svmBNB and SOON Mainnet while the foundation investigates, leaving users unable to bridge assets through either route.

The announcement did not disclose the scale of assets involved in the abnormal withdrawals or any specific losses. SOON said it will publish further information as the investigation progresses.

title_zh: Coinbase 第三方供应商问题再度上演：Amplitude 数据泄露
title_en: Coinbase's Third-Party Vendor Problem Strikes Again With Amplitude Leak
summary_zh:
Coinbase 证实其第三方产品分析服务商 Amplitude 发生安全事件，导致一小部分 Coinbase 客户的联系人信息与其他 Amplitude 客户的数据一同外泄。Coinbase 表示其自身平台并未遭到入侵，并否认了流传的“7 万名用户受影响”的说法。

该事件延续了原报道标题所称的 Coinbase 反复出现的问题：客户数据是经由外部供应商流出，而非 Coinbase 自身系统被攻破。泄露的联系方式为攻击者针对交易所用户实施钓鱼和社工攻击提供了素材。

据 The CyberSec Guru 报道，Coinbase 于 10 月 28 日披露了这起 Amplitude 事件。相关报道同时指出，Coinbase 的立场是自身“并未发生数据泄露”，影响源于 Amplitude，且仅限于小部分客户联系人数据。
summary_en:
Coinbase acknowledged a security incident at Amplitude, its third-party product analytics provider, which exposed contact information belonging to a small subset of Coinbase customers alongside other Amplitude customers. Coinbase says its own platform was not breached, and the company has pushed back on circulating claims that 70,000 users were affected.

The incident extends a pattern the source headline frames as recurring for Coinbase: customer data leaving the exchange through outside vendors rather than through a breach of Coinbase's own systems. Exposed contact details give attackers material for phishing and social-engineering attempts aimed at exchange users.

According to The CyberSec Guru, Coinbase disclosed the Amplitude incident on October 28. Reporting also notes that Coinbase's position is that it "has not had a data breach," with the impact attributed to Amplitude and limited to a small subset of customer contact data.

title_zh: 比特币赎回冻结令 1.36 亿美元 Aave 市场受到审视
title_en: Bitcoin redemption freeze puts $136 million Aave market under scrutiny
summary_zh:
据 CryptoSlate 报道，一项比特币赎回冻结令一个敞口约 1.36 亿美元的 Aave 借贷市场受到审视。此次赎回暂停引发了对该比特币锚定资产发行方偿付能力，以及该市场抵押品质量的质疑。

如果该比特币锚定资产的持有者无法将其兑换为原生 BTC，那么该 Aave 市场上作为贷款抵押品的资产，其实际价值可能低于链上价格所反映的水平，从而使该市场的贷款方面临潜在缺口。

1.36 亿美元指的是该 Aave 市场的敞口规模，而非已确认的损失。此次冻结涉及的是作为抵押品的比特币锚定代币的赎回，而非 Aave 协议本身出现故障。
summary_en:
A freeze on Bitcoin redemptions has put an Aave lending market holding roughly $136 million in exposure under scrutiny, according to CryptoSlate. The halt raises questions about the solvency of the Bitcoin-pegged asset's issuer and the quality of collateral backing that market.

If holders of the affected Bitcoin-pegged asset cannot redeem it for native BTC, the collateral backing loans on that Aave market may be worth less than its on-chain price implies, exposing lenders on that market to potential shortfalls.

The $136 million figure refers to the size of the Aave market's exposure, not a confirmed loss. The freeze concerns redemption of a Bitcoin-pegged token used as collateral rather than a failure of Aave itself.

title_zh: Cursor 在 Claude Code 市场出现恶意更新后敦促用户重置凭证
title_en: Cursor urges credential resets after malicious Claude Code marketplace update
summary_zh:
CryptoSlate 报道称，在 Claude Code 市场分发了一个恶意更新后，Cursor 建议用户重置凭证。目前尚未确认受影响用户数量或损失金额。

该事件使 AI 编程工具使用的开发者凭证和密钥面临风险，凸显了这些工具所依赖的插件生态中的供应链信任问题。

恶意更新通过 Claude Code 市场传播，Cursor 的回应是通知用户重置凭证。入侵范围，包括哪些凭证可能暴露，尚未得到确认。
summary_en:
CryptoSlate reported that Cursor advised users to reset credentials after a malicious update was distributed through the Claude Code marketplace. No affected-user count or loss figure has been confirmed.

The incident puts developer credentials and secrets used with AI coding tools at risk, underscoring supply-chain trust in the plugin ecosystems those tools rely on.

The malicious update came through the Claude Code marketplace, and Cursor's response was to tell users to reset credentials. The scope of the compromise, including which credentials were exposed, has not been confirmed.

title_zh: 马斯克称Colossus 2年底将部署120万块Blackwell，20万块专门跑推理
title_en: Musk says Colossus 2 will deploy 1.2 million Blackwell GPUs by year-end, with 200,000 dedicated to inference
summary_zh:
马斯克披露，xAI位于孟菲斯的超级计算集群 Colossus 2 计划在年底前部署约 120 万块英伟达 Blackwell GPU。接下来还有两座设施投运：Gun Range 预计 11 月底上线 22 万块 GB300，用于模型训练；Spam 由一座原本存放午餐肉等食品的仓库改造而来，计划部署约 20 万块 GB300，专门用于 AI 推理。

马斯克称，目前 Macrohard 配有 11 万块 GB200 和 22 万块 GB300，Macroharder、Minihard 各有 22 万块 GB300；加上计划新增的 42 万块，五个集群合计约 119 万块。他表示，Macroharder、Minihard 和 Gun Range 均采用 800Gbps 网卡，而 Spam 的推理任务网络配置更简单，所需光纤不到训练设施的一半。
summary_en:
Elon Musk disclosed that xAI's Memphis supercomputing cluster Colossus 2 plans to deploy roughly 1.2 million Nvidia Blackwell GPUs by the end of the year. Two additional facilities are slated to come online: Gun Range, expected around late November with 220,000 GB300s for model training, and Spam, converted from a warehouse that previously stored canned food such as luncheon meat, planned to host about 200,000 GB300s dedicated to AI inference.

Musk said Macrohard currently runs 110,000 GB200 and 220,000 GB300 GPUs, while Macroharder and Minihard each have 220,000 GB300s; adding the planned 420,000 brings the five clusters to about 1.19 million GPUs. Macroharder, Minihard and Gun Range all use 800Gbps network cards, whereas the Spam inference site needs a simpler network and less than half the fiber of the training facilities, he said.

title_zh: 【NXTT 拟出售或抵押 5833 枚比特币，价值约 4.49 亿美元】
title_en: NXTT Plans to Sell or Collateralize 5,833 Bitcoin Worth About $449 Million
summary_zh:
纳斯达克上市软件公司 Next Technology Holding（NXTT）表示，其董事会已授权分批出售或抵押其约 5833 枚比特币（约 4.49 亿美元）。公司给出的理由包括交易所漏洞（含币安攻击事件）以及量子计算对比特币密码学的潜在威胁；首席执行官 Weihong Liu 将决定交易的时机、价格和规模。

一家纳斯达克上市公司的企业金库公开以交易所交易对手风险和量子风险为由，出售或抵押其比特币，这标志着企业持币方对托管风险的表述出现明显变化。公司同时表示，该授权并不保证任何交易会最终完成。

NXTT 称其比特币并未存放在币安，也未通过币安持有；该授权涵盖交易所出售、私下协商交易以及比特币抵押融资。公司大部分比特币来自 2025 年 3 月的一笔交易，当时以股份、认股权证和现金预付款收购 5000 枚 BTC，总对价 1.581 亿美元，约合每枚 31600 美元。
summary_en:
Next Technology Holding (NXTT), a Nasdaq-listed software company, said its board has authorized the phased sale or collateralization of roughly 5,833 bitcoin, worth about $449 million. The company cited exchange vulnerabilities, including the Binance attack, and the potential threat quantum computing poses to Bitcoin's cryptography, with CEO Weihong Liu to decide the timing, pricing and size of any transactions.

A Nasdaq-listed corporate treasury publicly citing exchange counterparty risk and quantum risk as grounds to sell or pledge its bitcoin marks a notable shift in how corporate holders frame custody risk. The company said the authorization does not guarantee that any transactions will be completed.

NXTT said its bitcoin is not held at or through Binance, and the authorization covers exchange sales, privately negotiated transactions and bitcoin-collateralized financing. Most of the holdings came from a March 2025 deal in which it acquired 5,000 BTC for total consideration of $158.1 million, about $31,600 per coin, paid in shares, warrants and a cash prepayment.

title_zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF创下自推出以来最长的23个交易日连续净流出纪录
title_en: U.S. Spot Ethereum ETFs Hit Record 23-Day Net Outflow Streak Since Launch
summary_zh:
Glassnode 报告称，美国现货以太坊ETF已连续23个交易日出现净流出，创下这类基金推出以来最长的连续净流出纪录。这家链上分析机构表示，持续的资金撤出反映出传统金融投资者的需求正在走弱。

Glassnode 将这一连续净流出与在8月和9月大幅增持ETH的传统金融投资者转为撤出联系起来，使这组资金流数据成为衡量机构对以太坊敞口需求的指标。

净流出意味着在这些交易日中，基金份额的赎回规模超过新份额的创设规模，即资金在流出这些ETF，而不是流入。
summary_en:
Glassnode reported that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have posted 23 consecutive trading days of net outflows, their longest such streak since the funds launched. The on-chain analytics firm said the sustained withdrawals point to weakening demand from traditional-finance investors.

Glassnode linked the streak to a pullback by traditional-finance investors who had accumulated ETH heavily in August and September, making the flow data a gauge of institutional appetite for ether exposure.

A net outflow means redemptions from the funds exceeded new share creation on those trading days, so capital was leaving the ETFs rather than entering them.

title_zh: 数学已经改变，让我们也这样行动
title_en: Mathematics has changed. Let's act like it
summary_zh:
陶哲轩（Terence Tao）发表了一篇题为《数学已经改变，让我们也这样行动》的文章，认为人工智能已经足以改变数学研究的实践方式，研究者必须重新思考功劳归属、问题选择以及成果如何被领域消化吸收。该文在 Hacker News 上引发高热度讨论，议题聚焦于数学正从“手工艺”式研究转向工业化规模生产。

评论者认为，这篇文章延续了陶哲轩近几个月来的论点：在数学中，选择一个有价值的问题、完全借助人工智能得到证明、彻底理解该证明并由此提出新的问题，本身就可以构成实质性贡献，即使没有为原始证明提供任何新的要素。

讨论者用数学从“手工艺时代”走向“工业化生产时代”来形容这一变化，并质疑为何多数关于人工智能与数学的文章都假定其能力不会超越定理证明，而不会延伸到判断哪些问题值得研究、指挥大规模研究工作以及向外界解释发现等任务。
summary_en:
Terence Tao published an essay titled "Mathematics has changed. Let's act like it," arguing that AI has transformed mathematical practice enough that researchers must rethink how credit is assigned, how problems are selected, and how results are digested by the field. The post drew high-engagement discussion on Hacker News about mathematics shifting from craftsmanship toward industrial-scale production.

Commenters framed the essay as part of Tao's longer-running argument that, in mathematics, choosing a worthwhile problem, obtaining a proof entirely with AI, understanding it thoroughly and developing further questions from it can itself constitute a substantial contribution — even without supplying a new ingredient to the original proof.

Discussants described the shift in terms of mathematics moving from an age of craftsmanship to an age of industrial production, and questioned why most writing on AI in mathematics assumes capabilities will not extend beyond theorem proving to tasks such as choosing which problems are worth pursuing, steering large-scale efforts, and explaining findings.

title_zh: OKXICE 股票代币反对企业增至 50 家，英伟达在列
title_en: OKXICE Stock-Token Objections Reach 50, Including Nvidia
summary_zh:
据 The Defiant 报道，反对自身股票在 OKX-ICE 平台以代币形式交易的企业数量已升至 50 家，英伟达（Nvidia）位列其中。此前的报道显示这一数字为 26 家，当时甲骨文、IBM、英特尔和 IonQ 加入了反对行列。

反对名单的扩大表明企业对代币化股票的抵制正在加强。这一品类在国际市场持续扩张，但美国企业对在本土发行锚定自身股票的代币持抗拒态度。

此前的报道称反对企业为 26 家，当时甲骨文、IBM、英特尔和 IonQ 反对其股票在 OKX-ICE 平台以代币形式交易。相关报道的关注点集中在 SEC 关于代币化股票需获得发行方同意的规则上。
summary_en:
The number of companies objecting to their shares being traded as tokens on the OKX-ICE venue has risen to 50, according to The Defiant, with Nvidia among the objectors. The figure is up from the 26 objections reported earlier, when Oracle, IBM, Intel and IonQ joined the list.

The widening list signals growing corporate pushback against tokenized equities, a segment that has been expanding in international markets even as U.S. companies resist domestic issuance of tokens tied to their shares.

Earlier reporting put the objection count at 26, after Oracle, IBM, Intel and IonQ objected to their stock trading as tokens on the OKX-ICE venue. Coverage of those objections has focused on SEC rules concerning issuer consent for tokenized equities.

title_zh: 朝鲜每25秒启用一个新钱包，洗白币安被盗资金
title_en: North Korea Is Laundering Binance Hack Loot at One New Wallet Every 25 Seconds
summary_zh:
区块链分析公司 Elliptic 在周一发布的报告中称，币安 64.3 亿美元被盗案的实施者在不到四天内将资金分散到 11 条区块链上的约 1.2 万个钱包，交易超过 4 万笔——大约每 25 秒就启用一个新钱包。Elliptic 表示，在 Tether 与 Circle 出手冻结被盗稳定币后，约 28.5 亿美元（占 44%）已被冻结或查扣。

据 Elliptic 数据，本次 44% 的冻结或查扣比例远高于 2025 年 2 月朝鲜盗取 Bybit 15 亿美元后约 3% 的水平，该公司将此归因于稳定币发行方在数分钟内采取了行动。

Elliptic 发现，Tether 在被盗 USDT 到达攻击者钱包后 37 分钟即于以太坊上完成冻结，Circle 则在全部 8.23 亿美元被盗 USDC 被兑换前予以冻结；但仍有约 7.86 亿美元稳定币流出。该公司表示，这一洗钱过程明显是自动化的，但没有证据显示由 AI 做决策，理由是时间间隔固定、金额设定统一、盲目重试，以及类似人类工作时间的停顿。
summary_en:
Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic said in an analysis published Monday that in under four days the attacker behind the $6.43 billion Binance theft spread the funds across roughly 12,000 wallets on 11 blockchains in more than 40,000 transactions — about one new wallet every 25 seconds. Elliptic reported that about $2.85 billion, or 44% of the haul, has already been frozen or seized after Tether and Circle moved to lock up stolen stablecoins.

The 44% freeze-or-seizure rate compares with roughly 3% after North Korea's $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025, according to Elliptic, which attributes the difference to stablecoin issuers acting within minutes.

Elliptic found Tether froze stolen USDT on Ethereum 37 minutes after it reached the attacker's wallet, and Circle froze all $823 million in stolen USDC before any could be swapped; about $786 million in stablecoins nonetheless escaped. The firm said the laundering is clearly automated but shows no AI decision-making, citing fixed timing, set amounts, blind retries and pauses resembling human working hours.

title_zh: Claude 构建的 Linux 漏洞利用，瞄准 Ubuntu 仍未修补的内核漏洞
title_en: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
summary_zh:
Anthropic 表示，Claude 使用一个尚未发布的内部模型，为 CVE-2026-98432 写出了可用的远程漏洞利用程序。该漏洞是 Linux 内核 IPv4 TCP 握手路径中的释放后使用（use-after-free）缺陷，严重性评分 9.8，影响 4.4 及之后的內核版本。该攻击在 10 月 27 日的一篇研究文章中披露，覆盖 Chrome、Safari、Android、Windows 和 Linux 五个目标，定位内存缺陷耗时不到一小时，再花约五分钟即可执行获得 root 权限的命令。

Ubuntu 官方跟踪页面仍将 16.04 至 26.10 的所有版本列为受影响，而红帽已于 11 月 1 日（周日）为 RHEL 8、9、10 发布修复，包括安全公告 RHSA-2026:93412。Go 安全团队警告称，底层缺陷并不局限于 Anthropic 演示所用攻击所依赖的 MPTCP 特性，并建议升级到已修补的内核。

Anthropic 写道，该漏洞属于竞态条件，竞争失败只会导致握手失败而不会使系统崩溃，因此攻击者可以无限次重试。红帽发布了一条临时防火墙规则，称其“可降低暴露于该漏洞的风险，但无法完全阻止”，完整的解决方案仍在开发中；Debian、SUSE、Oracle Linux 和 Amazon Linux 也已为至少部分版本发布修复。
summary_en:
Anthropic said Claude, using an unreleased internal model, wrote a working remote exploit for CVE-2026-98432, a use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handshake path rated 9.8 for severity that affects kernel versions from 4.4 onward. The attack was described in an Oct. 27 research post covering five targets — Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux — and takes under an hour to locate the memory flaw plus about five minutes to execute a command with root access.

Ubuntu's own tracker still lists every release from 16.04 through 26.10 as affected, while Red Hat shipped fixes for RHEL 8, 9 and 10 on Sunday, Nov. 1, including advisory RHSA-2026:93412. The Go Security Team warned that the underlying bug is not specific to MPTCP, the feature Anthropic's demonstrated exploit requires, and recommended upgrading to a patched kernel.

Anthropic wrote that the bug is a race condition where a lost race only fails the handshake without crashing the system, so an attacker can retry indefinitely. Red Hat published a temporary firewall rule that it says "reduces exposure to this vulnerability but cannot fully prevent it," with a full solution still under development; Debian, SUSE, Oracle Linux and Amazon Linux have also shipped fixes for at least some versions.

title_zh: Mercado Bitcoin 黑客攻击损失已达 4600 万美元，且仍在扩大
title_en: Mercado Bitcoin hack losses are at $46M and growing
summary_zh:
巴西交易所 Mercado Bitcoin 周一暂停了充值与提现，称当天凌晨在其一个系统中发现了安全事件。区块链安全公司 Hypernative 标记了横跨至少 10 条区块链、总额超过 4000 万美元的可疑转账；Arkham 分析师 Emmett Gallic 则表示损失已超过 4600 万美元，并称攻击者仍在扫荡旧充值地址、抛售 meme 币和山寨币。

该交易所称客户资金与数据均未受影响，但全平台的充提暂停使所有用户在资金仍被链上追踪期间无法转移资产。据 Tether 首席执行官 Paolo Ardoino 表示，Tether 已冻结了与此次事件相关的超过 450 万枚 USDT。

Mercado Bitcoin 公布了攻击者在五类网络上的收款地址——EVM 链、比特币、Solana、Stellar 和 Tron——称公布目的是便于他人识别和追踪这些资金；该交易所尚未确认 4000 多万美元这一数字，也未披露攻击者如何入侵。Hypernative 的初步分析涵盖至少 10 条区块链，包括比特币、以太坊、Solana 和 Tron。
summary_en:
Brazilian exchange Mercado Bitcoin suspended deposits and withdrawals on Monday after detecting a security incident in one of its systems in the early hours of the morning. Blockchain security firm Hypernative flagged more than $40 million in suspicious transfers across at least 10 blockchains, while Arkham analyst Emmett Gallic put the losses at over $46 million and said the attacker is still sweeping old deposit addresses and selling off memecoins and altcoins.

The exchange says no customer funds or data were affected, but the platform-wide suspension of deposits and withdrawals blocks all users from moving assets while funds are still being traced on-chain. Tether has frozen more than 4.5 million USDT tied to the incident, according to CEO Paolo Ardoino.

Mercado Bitcoin published attacker destination addresses on five networks — EVM chains, Bitcoin, Solana, Stellar and Tron — saying they were released so others can identify and track the funds, and it has not confirmed the $40 million-plus figure or disclosed how the attackers gained access. Hypernative's preliminary analysis spans at least 10 blockchains, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron.

title_zh: 【ZachXBT：欧盟某实体疑从多个中心化交易所账户被盗超 1.06 亿美元】
title_en: ZachXBT: An EU entity suspected of having over $106 million stolen from multiple centralized exchange accounts
summary_zh:
区块链调查员 ZachXBT 周一在 Telegram 发帖预警称，欧盟一个未具名实体疑似于 11 月 1 日（周日）从多个中心化交易所账户被盗走超过 1.06 亿美元，资金以 USDC 和 USDT 形式被提出。过去 24 小时内，攻击者将 USDC 兑换为 ETH，经 WellWallet、Kyrrex 等即时兑换平台转移，并通过 Wagyu 兑换为门罗币（XMR），同时跨多条链搬运资金；ZachXBT 已公布 11 个相关地址。

ZachXBT 表示“高度确信”攻击者并非朝鲜 Lazarus 组织，这与近期的币安被盗案有所不同。预警发布时资金仍在通过即时兑换平台和隐私币兑换持续转移，说明洗钱过程尚未结束。

受影响实体及涉事交易所均未公开，攻击者身份也尚未查明。Lookonchain 称，地址 0x9eca 在链上以约 2,286 美元均价买入 27,553 枚 ETH（约 6,297 万美元），属于此次资金转移的一部分。
summary_en:
Blockchain investigator ZachXBT warned in a Monday Telegram post that an unidentified entity in the European Union appears to have had more than $106 million drained from several centralized exchange accounts on Sunday, Nov. 1, with the funds withdrawn in USDC and USDT. Over the following 24 hours the suspected attacker swapped USDC into ETH, moved funds through instant-exchange services including WellWallet and Kyrrex, converted them into Monero (XMR) via the swap service Wagyu, and bridged assets across multiple chains; ZachXBT published 11 associated addresses.

ZachXBT said with "a high degree of confidence" that the attacker is not North Korea's Lazarus Group, setting this incident apart from the recent Binance hack. The funds were still being moved through instant-swap venues and privacy coin conversion at the time of the alert, indicating the laundering is ongoing.

The affected entity and the exchanges involved have not been publicly named, and the attacker remains unidentified. Lookonchain reported that wallet 0x9eca bought 27,553 ETH (about $62.97 million) on-chain at an average price of $2,286 as part of the fund movement.

title_zh: Anthropic警告称已非常接近RSI能力，即“自我构建式”AI
title_en: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
summary_zh:
Anthropic公开警告称，公司正接近“递归自我改进”（RSI）能力，即AI系统已足够擅长训练自身的后继系统、从而推动能力急剧加速的临界点，并将这一时刻界定为关键的安全关口。

Anthropic的这一表述将RSI置于争论的核心：前沿实验室应以多快速度部署能力不断增强的系统，以及监管机构应如何构建对这一过程的监督。

这一表态是对“接近程度”的判断，而非已展示的能力跃升或已披露的安全事件。RSI被描述为AI在自我训练上变得极为高效、从而令能力提升大幅加速的那个节点。
summary_en:
Anthropic publicly cautioned that it is approaching recursive self-improvement (RSI) — the threshold at which AI systems become good enough at training their own successors to drive a sharp acceleration in capabilities — framing the moment as a critical safety juncture.

Anthropic's framing places RSI at the center of the debate over how quickly frontier labs should deploy increasingly capable systems and how regulators should structure oversight of that process.

The statement is an assessment of proximity rather than a demonstrated capability jump or a disclosed safety incident. RSI is described as the point where AI becomes so effective at training itself that capability gains accelerate dramatically.

title_zh: Astra 能够读写权重以改进 Qwen
title_en: Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen
summary_zh:
一位研究者发布了一项名为“权重空间编程”（weight-space programming）的演示：名为 Astra 的大模型直接检视神经网络的权重并加以编辑以改变模型行为，且全程不允许它编写训练循环。在文中给出的例子中，Astra 将一个小型推理模型的重复循环归因于第 15 层和第 19 层 MLP 写出的某个方向，并从每层 64 个输出列（共 131,072 个权重）中减去该方向；它还直接编辑了一个小型 Qwen 模型的权重，在没有重新训练的情况下将其数学能力提升了数倍。

Hacker News 上的评论者认为，这一演示是引人注目的证据，说明当前的大模型可能对自身权重结构具备某种“原生”理解，而不必依赖外部工具来检视权重。不过该工作属于单人博客演示，并非经过同行评审的成果，也非前沿实验室的正式发布。

根据文中描述，在编辑权重之前，该基座模型前 96 次练习作答中有 85 次触及 32,768 token 的上限。作者将这一方法概括为：利用模型的推理能力判断网络各部分实际计算什么、应当计算什么，然后据此修改权重。
summary_en:
A researcher has published a demonstration of "weight-space programming," in which an LLM called Astra inspects a neural network's weights directly and edits them to change model behavior, without being allowed to write training loops. In the reported examples, Astra traced a small reasoning model's repetitive looping to a direction written by the MLP layers 15 and 19 and subtracted it from 64 output columns in each layer (131,072 weights), and separately edited a small Qwen model's weights to improve its math performance several-fold without retraining.

Commenters on Hacker News described the demonstration as striking evidence that current LLMs may hold some native understanding of their own weight structure rather than requiring external tooling to inspect it. The work is presented as a single-author blog demonstration, not a peer-reviewed or frontier-lab release.

According to the write-up, 85 of the base model's first 96 practice answers ran to the 32,768-token limit before the weight edit. The author frames the approach as using the model's reasoning to work out what each part of the network computes, or should compute, and then changing weights accordingly.

title_zh: Arbitrum 安全委员会可在无密钥情况下转移钱包资金，币安冻结事件提供例证
title_en: Arbitrum’s Security Council Can Move a Wallet’s Funds Without Its Key, Binance Freeze Shows
summary_zh:
在一宗与币安相关的冻结事件中，Arbitrum 安全委员会展示了它可以在不掌握钱包私钥的情况下转移该钱包中的资金。这一事件暴露的是该 Layer 2 的紧急处置权限，而非协议漏洞被利用。

该事件为长期存在的疑问提供了一个具体案例：Layer 2 的紧急多签究竟对用户资金保留多大控制权。这对 Arbitrum 的去中心化程度与用户信任都是核心问题。

根据治理文档与 Tally 的委员会页面，Arbitrum 安全委员会是由 ARB 代币持有人选举产生的 9-of-12 多签，可冻结资金、暂停系统并处理紧急情况。
summary_en:
Arbitrum's Security Council demonstrated that it can transfer funds out of a wallet without possessing that wallet's private key, in an incident tied to a freeze associated with Binance. The episode surfaced the Layer 2's emergency powers rather than a protocol exploit.

The case puts a concrete example behind long-standing questions about how much control a Layer 2's emergency multisig retains over user funds, a core decentralization and user-trust issue for Arbitrum.

Arbitrum's Security Council is a 9-of-12 multisig elected by ARB token holders that can freeze funds, pause the system and handle emergency situations, according to governance documentation and Tally's council page.

title_zh: 甲骨文申请发行200亿美元新股与债券，为AI基础设施建设融资
title_en: Oracle files to sell $20B in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
summary_zh:
甲骨文（Oracle）已提交文件，拟通过发行新股与债券合计融资200亿美元，所筹资金将用于其人工智能基础设施的建设。该文件属于证券发行的注册申报，并非已完成的交易；目前尚未披露发行定价以及股权与债务融资的最终比例。

此次申报把甲骨文的AI数据中心投入直接摆到了股票与信用投资者面前，也引出市场已开始定价的两个问题：现有股东将被稀释多少，以及支撑这些支出的长期AI云合同能否经受时间考验。

甲骨文的AI云订单储备一直是其估值的重要支撑，在2027财年第一季度签下逾300亿美元新AI云合同后，其剩余履约义务总额据报达到6640亿美元。有评论者指出，若200亿美元中约一半通过股权融资，按当前市值计算意味着约2.5%的稀释，而该股股价已下跌8%。
summary_en:
Oracle has filed to raise $20 billion through a combination of new stock and bonds, with proceeds intended to finance its AI infrastructure buildout. The filing is a registration to issue securities, not a completed sale; no pricing or final split between equity and debt has been disclosed in the source.

The filing puts Oracle's AI data-center commitments in front of public equity and credit investors, raising questions the market has already begun to price: how much existing shareholders will be diluted, and whether the long-term AI cloud contracts underpinning the spending hold up over time.

Oracle's AI cloud backlog has been a key support for its valuation, with total remaining performance obligations reported at $664 billion after signing more than $30 billion in new AI cloud contracts in Q1 FY2027. Commenters on the filing noted that if roughly half the $20 billion is raised in equity, that implies dilution of about 2.5% at the current market capitalization, while the stock fell 8%.

title_zh: 《纽约时报》等媒体起诉 Brave 浏览器，指控其抓取内容
title_en: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
summary_zh:
《纽约时报》联合《纽约每日新闻》《芝加哥论坛报》等多家出版机构对隐私浏览器公司 Brave 提起诉讼，指控其抓取受版权保护的内容并违规分发给 AI 客户。诉状于周一提交，点名 Anthropic、Perplexity、Mistral、xAI 和 Cohere 为内容接收方，同时质疑 Brave 的“付费墙拦截器”功能，称其让用户绕过出版商的付费墙。

这些诉讼瞄准的是 AI 搜索的供给层——即把出版商新闻内容输送给模型开发者的索引与 API，而非某一次模型训练，这使 Brave 的商业搜索 API 及其绕过付费墙的功能直接面临法律质疑。

诉状引用 Brave 2023 年的一份指南，其中将 API 最常见的用途描述为对大语言模型进行“训练与接地（grounding）”；而 Brave 现行 API 条款（2026 年 9 月 1 日更新）禁止客户缓存、转售结果，或用其训练和改进 AI 模型。截至起诉之时，这些都还只是诉状中的指控，法院尚未作出任何裁决。
summary_en:
The New York Times and a group of other publishers, including the New York Daily News and the Chicago Tribune, filed lawsuits against Brave, the company behind the privacy-focused browser, alleging it scraped their copyrighted content and unlawfully distributed it to AI customers. The complaints, filed Monday, name Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI and Cohere as recipients of that content, and also challenge Brave's "Paywall blocker" feature, which the suit says let users bypass publishers' paywalls.

The suits target the supply layer of AI search — the index and API through which publishers' journalism reaches model developers — rather than a single model's training run, putting Brave's commercial search API and its paywall-bypass feature directly in legal question.

The complaint cites a 2023 Brave guide describing the most common API uses as "training and grounding" large language models, while Brave's current API terms, updated September 1, 2026, bar customers from caching or reselling results or using them to train or improve AI models. As of the filing these are allegations in a complaint; no court has ruled on the claims.

title_zh: 【渣打银行在香港推出代币化存款服务】
title_en: Standard Chartered launches tokenized deposit service in Hong Kong
summary_zh:
渣打银行宣布在香港推出面向企业客户的代币化存款解决方案，香港成为其全球网络中首个推出该方案的市场，后续计划扩展至更多市场。该方案基于渣打自有区块链基础设施，在香港金管局分布式账本技术监管孵化器支持下开发，依托 EnsembleTX，代币化存款可在参与银行之间实时转账，并以包括批发型央行数字货币在内的央行货币进行 7×24 小时银行间结算。

该方案面向企业客户的集团内部流动性管理及数字化财资和投资流程，使参与银行之间的代币化存款转账能够以央行货币进行全天候结算。

据 BlockBeats 11 月 2 日援引 Coindesk 报道，早期合作伙伴包括华夏基金（China AMC）、Fireblocks 和 HashKey。目前香港是渣打唯一推出该服务的市场。
summary_en:
Standard Chartered announced the launch of a tokenized deposit solution for corporate clients in Hong Kong, making the city the first market in its global network to offer the service, with plans to extend it to more markets. Built on the bank's own blockchain infrastructure and developed with support from the HKMA's distributed ledger technology regulatory incubator, the solution relies on EnsembleTX to let tokenized deposits move between participating banks in real time, with interbank settlement in central bank money — including wholesale CBDC — on a 24/7 basis.

The service is aimed at corporate clients' intra-group liquidity management and digital treasury and investment workflows, allowing tokenized deposit transfers among participating banks to be settled in central bank money around the clock.

BlockBeats reported on November 2, citing CoinDesk, that early partners include China AMC, Fireblocks and HashKey. Hong Kong is currently the only market where the bank offers the service.

title_zh: BTCPay Server：攻击面指向2.4.1及更早版本，最新版暂无可信热钱包被盗报告
title_en: BTCPay Server: Attack surface points to version 2.4.1 and earlier, no credible hot wallet theft reports on latest release
summary_zh:
11 月 2 日，BTCPay Server 表示其事件响应调查已识别出攻击面，主要针对运行 2.4.1 版本（发布于 2026 年 7 月 23 日）及更早版本的实例。官方称目前暂无运行最新 2.4.7 版本用户热钱包被盗的可信报告，并再次敦促所有运营方及时升级。

BTCPay Server 是由商户自行部署的自托管支付基础设施，因此风险集中在尚未升级到 2.4.1 以上版本的运营方。BTCPay 尚未披露受影响的运营方数量或被盗资金规模。

BTCPay 要求受影响用户向其安全团队提交信息和日志，但尚未公布攻击者如何访问钱包的技术细节。Cointelegraph 称其联系 BTCPay Server 寻求置评，但在发稿前未获回应。
summary_en:
On November 2, BTCPay Server said its incident response investigation had identified an attack vector mainly targeting instances running version 2.4.1 — released July 23, 2026 — or earlier. The project said it has received no credible reports of hot wallet drains among users running the latest release, version 2.4.7, and again urged all operators to upgrade promptly.

BTCPay Server is self-hosted payment infrastructure run directly by merchants, so the exposure is concentrated among operators who have not updated past 2.4.1. BTCPay has not disclosed how many operators were affected or the value of any stolen funds.

BTCPay asked affected users to submit information and logs to its security team, and has not released technical details on how attackers accessed the wallets. Cointelegraph said it reached out to BTCPay Server for comment but received no response before publication.

title_zh: THORChain因安全漏洞暂停跨链兑换，中断币安被盗资金的洗钱路径
title_en: THORChain Halts Cross-Chain Swaps Over Security Flaw, Disrupting Laundering of Binance Hack Funds
summary_zh:
在发现一处安全漏洞后，THORChain暂停了跨链兑换功能。据报道，此次暂停同时切断了据称被用于转移币安黑客事件被盗资金的一条通道。

此次暂停使一个被广泛使用的去中心化跨链兑换平台对用户停止服务，并且据报中断了币安被盗资金的一条洗钱路径。

该措施被描述为在发现漏洞后采取的预防性暂停，而非已确认的漏洞利用事件，报道中未给出用户损失的具体数字。
summary_en:
THORChain suspended cross-chain swaps after a security flaw was identified in the protocol. According to the report, the halt also cut off a route that had reportedly been used to move funds stolen in the Binance hack.

The halt takes a widely used decentralized cross-chain swap venue offline for users, and per the report interrupts a laundering path for stolen Binance funds.

The measure is described as a precautionary halt tied to an identified flaw rather than a confirmed exploit, and no user losses have been quantified in the report.

title_zh: THORChain：某用户主动退回10枚ETH，金库已恢复偿付能力
title_en: THORChain: A User Voluntarily Returned 10 ETH, Treasury Solvency Restored
summary_zh:
THORChain 表示，10 月 31 日以太坊发生一次单区块重组，导致协议错误支付了从未实际到账的 10 枚 ETH；目前该用户已主动退回这 10 枚 ETH，金库恢复偿付能力。AVAX、BASE、RUNE 和 XRPL 上的交易保持活跃，而 ATOM、BCH、BSC、BTC、DOGE、ETH、LTC、SOL、TRON、ZEC 共十条链的交易仍处于暂停状态，等待安全检查与修复。

该事件显示，一次常规的以太坊重组也可能在跨链协议中造成资金流出，且处置过程需要暂停十条主要链上的交易。THORChain 强调，紧急暂停机制由节点投票控制，不会赋予节点对资产的控制权。

协议的自动偿付能力检查机制立即触发并暂停了 ETH 兑换，约两分钟内节点运营者进一步暂停 ETH 交易签名，以防止资金继续流出。节点运营商将在确认各链安全后决定是否重新启用相关链，核心开发团队正推进相关修复。
summary_en:
THORChain said that on October 31 an Ethereum single-block reorganization caused the protocol to erroneously pay out 10 ETH that had never actually been received, and that the user has since voluntarily returned the 10 ETH, restoring treasury solvency. Trading remains paused across ten chains — ATOM, BCH, BSC, BTC, DOGE, ETH, LTC, SOL, TRON and ZEC — while AVAX, BASE, RUNE and XRPL remain active, pending safety checks and fixes.

The incident shows that a routine Ethereum reorg can lead to value leakage in a cross-chain protocol, and that remediation required halting trading across ten major chains. THORChain stressed that the emergency pause mechanism is controlled by node voting and does not give nodes control over assets.

The protocol's automatic solvency check triggered immediately and paused ETH swaps, and within about two minutes node operators further suspended ETH transaction signing to stop further outflows. Node operators will decide whether to re-enable each chain after confirming it is safe, and the core development team is working on fixes.

title_zh: CryptoCom 将于 2027 年 2 月 1 日停止在香港提供消费者应用
title_en: CryptoCom to Discontinue Consumer App in Hong Kong on February 1, 2027
summary_zh:
据彭博社报道，CryptoCom 将于 2027 年 2 月 1 日起停止在香港提供消费者应用。公司称此举是为优化全球运营与资源配置，并表示已通知受影响用户，后续将向其提供账户关闭与资金提取的指引。

此次停服意味着 CryptoCom 将撤出面向香港零售用户的应用程序，而公司同时仍在通过 Foris DAX HK Limited 为其机构级交易所申请香港证监会虚拟资产交易平台牌照，香港个人用户因此面临明确的账户关闭与提币期限。

消费者应用的下线日期为 2027 年 2 月 1 日，公司将其定位为运营与资源配置层面的决定，而非监管处罚或 insolvency 事件。面向机构的 CryptoCom Exchange 业务及其在香港另行推进的牌照申请据称将继续进行。
summary_en:
CryptoCom will discontinue its consumer app in Hong Kong effective February 1, 2027, according to Bloomberg. The company said the move is part of efforts to optimize global operations and resource allocation, and that affected users have been notified and will receive instructions on account closures and fund withdrawals.

The shutdown removes CryptoCom's retail-facing app from Hong Kong even as the company keeps pursuing an SFC virtual asset trading platform license through Foris DAX HK Limited for its institutional exchange, leaving Hong Kong consumer users with a fixed deadline to close accounts and withdraw funds.

The consumer app closure is dated February 1, 2027, and is framed as an operational and resource-allocation decision rather than a regulatory action or insolvency event. The institutional CryptoCom Exchange business and its separate licensing application in Hong Kong are described as continuing.

title_zh: 币安曾依赖AI打击欺诈，随后黑客利用内部工具实施60亿美元盗窃
title_en: Binance relied on AI to fight fraud before hackers exploited internal tool in $6 billion theft
summary_zh:
币安在事件报告中披露了一起持续数月攻击行动：攻击者通过虚假面试入侵了一名工程师的工作电脑，随后利用对内部钱包签名服务的未授权访问，绕过正常提币流程发起交易。币安报告给出的金额约为63亿美元，而相关报道提及的盗窃规模约为60亿美元。

币安表示已在全新环境中重建受影响的钱包系统以应对此次事件，这使该漏洞成为检验交易所控制的签名基础设施安全性的直接案例。

根据币安的说法，攻击在盗窃当晚迅速展开，攻击者触及的是内部签名服务而非标准提币路径。被入侵的工程师电脑上还运行着一款内部AI工具，报告将该工具与此次入侵联系起来。
summary_en:
Binance's incident report described a monthslong campaign in which attackers used fake job interviews to compromise an engineer's work computer and then exploited unauthorized access to an internal wallet signing service to initiate transactions outside the normal withdrawal process. The exchange's report put the figure at roughly $6.3 billion, while coverage of the theft cited about $6 billion.

Binance said it has rebuilt the affected wallet system in a new environment in response to the incident, making the breach a direct test of how exchange-controlled signing infrastructure is secured.

According to Binance's account, the attack unfolded quickly on the evening of the theft, with the attacker reaching the internal signing service rather than the standard withdrawal path. The compromised engineer's machine also hosted an internal AI tool, which the report tied to the intrusion.

title_zh: CFTC主席称股票永续合约可在美国开始交易
title_en: CFTC Chair Says Equity Perps Can Begin US Trading
summary_zh:
美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）主席迈克尔·塞利格周二发表声明称，挂钩单只股票的永续期货合约首次获准在CFTC注册交易所开始交易，该批准依据CFTC第40.3条规则作出。此类合约可在同时向CFTC和SEC注册、具备证券期货产品交易资格的交易所提供；塞利格未指明具体哪家交易所将上架，也未给出开始交易的时间表。

塞利格将此举描述为让美国交易者在国内监管保障下获得永续期货，而不必“被迫转向离岸且往往缺乏监管的交易场所”。Kraken 公开回应“coming soon 👀”，暗示商业化落地在即。

该声明发布前，Coinbase、Kalshi 以及 Kraken 母公司 Payward（通过其 Bitnomial 交易所）于9月提交了挂钩美国单只股票的永续期货申请，OG.com 随后加入。周二下午，由 Cboe、Citadel Securities 和 Healthy Markets 等组成的资本市场联盟（Capital Markets Alliance）提起诉讼要求撤销这些批准，主张相关合约属于SEC管辖的证券型互换，并指CFTC违反了《行政程序法》，同时请求在诉讼期间阻止批准生效。
summary_en:
CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said in a Tuesday statement that perpetual futures on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges, having been deemed approved under CFTC Regulation 40.3. The contracts may be offered on exchanges registered with both the CFTC and the SEC to trade security futures products; Selig did not name which venues would list them or give a start date.

Selig framed the move as letting US traders access perpetual futures under domestic safeguards rather than being "forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues." Kraken responded publicly with "coming soon 👀", signaling commercial follow-through.

The announcement follows September filings by Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward (through its Bitnomial exchange), and later OG.com, seeking approval for perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks. On Tuesday afternoon, the Capital Markets Alliance — a coalition including Cboe, Citadel Securities and Healthy Markets — sued to overturn the approvals, arguing the contracts are security-based swaps under SEC jurisdiction and that the CFTC violated the Administrative Procedure Act, and sought to block them from taking effect while the case proceeds.

title_zh: 巴西最大比特币交易所称在4000万美元黑客攻击后将向用户退款
title_en: Brazil's Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
summary_zh:
巴西最大加密货币交易所 Mercado Bitcoin 表示，11月2日凌晨在其一个系统中发现安全事件，并作为预防措施暂停了充值和提现，同时承诺由交易所自身承担损失，而不是转嫁给客户。该交易所称涉案资产价值约3800万美元，并称在 Tether、Circle、Paxos、BRL1 和 Chainalysis 的协助下已拦截1100万美元，而外部追踪机构的估算更高。

赔付承诺的可靠性取决于背后的资金实力，而交易所无需向客户公开账目，因此这一承诺无法从外部核实。充值和提现仍处于暂停状态且没有恢复时间表，用户无法调动资金。

损失估算存在差异：Hypernative 标记了至少10条区块链（包括比特币、以太坊、Solana 和 Tron）上超过4000万美元的可疑转账；Arkham 追踪到至少4600万美元，Chainalysis 估算约4900万美元，其中近1000万美元被冻结。Mercado Bitcoin 称没有客户资金损失、没有数据泄露，但未说明其3800万美元的数字是否包含已冻结金额，也未说明攻击者如何入侵；Tether 首席执行官 Paolo Ardoino 表示，Tether 已冻结与该事件相关的逾450万美元 USDT。
summary_en:
Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil's largest crypto exchange, said it detected a security incident in one of its systems early on November 2 and froze deposits and withdrawals as a precaution, pledging to absorb the losses itself rather than pass them to customers. The exchange put the value of assets involved at about $38 million and said it had already blocked $11 million with help from Tether, Circle, Paxos, BRL1 and Chainalysis, while outside trackers estimate higher losses.

A guarantee to cover losses is only as good as the money behind it, and exchanges are not required to show customers their books, so the pledge cannot be verified from outside. Deposits and withdrawals remain suspended with no restart date, leaving users unable to move funds.

Loss estimates vary: Hypernative flagged more than $40 million in suspicious transfers across at least 10 blockchains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron; Arkham traced at least $46 million and Chainalysis about $49 million, with nearly $10 million frozen. Mercado Bitcoin said no customer lost money and no data leaked, did not say whether its $38 million figure includes the frozen amount, and has not said how attackers got in; Tether froze more than $4.5 million in USDT tied to the incident, according to CEO Paolo Ardoino.

title_zh: 更新：我已识别出该非法行为者额外逾2700万美元的CEX提现
title_en: Update: I’ve identified an additional $27M+ of CEX withdrawals by the illicit ac
summary_zh:
一名在Telegram频道“investigations”上发布信息的调查者表示，其新识别出该非法行为者额外逾2700万美元的中心化交易所（CEX）提现，使该事件涉及总额升至逾1.33亿美元。据该帖文称，其中一部分CEX提现在其首次披露之后才发生。

该调查者称，由于没有进行正式的事件披露，超过3000万美元被洗走，而这些资金本可被欧盟执法机构冻结。其工作假设是，一家西欧大型金融机构遭到攻击利用，而此事目前正被掩盖——这属于推测，而非已确认的结论。

该帖文列出四个被认定为盗窃地址的以太坊地址：0x5cf70edce65847ef989933c3072fb0e7f335abc1、0xe378cdccb369a64a0190577787ef61ca2eefa6b2、0x3e6c3d135ca8f8be793e5fe1715ce6c057d140f2 以及 0x99d314e6970b8d3db0dbe6f6e041cc904143400f。
summary_en:
An investigator posting on the Telegram channel "investigations" said they identified an additional $27M+ in centralized exchange (CEX) withdrawals by the illicit actor behind an incident whose total now exceeds $133M. According to the post, a portion of those CEX withdrawals took place after the investigator's initial disclosure.

The investigator states that the absence of a proper incident disclosure allowed $30M+ to be laundered away that EU law enforcement could otherwise have frozen. The investigator's working theory is that a large Western European financial institution was exploited and that the matter is currently being covered up — a hypothesis, not a confirmed finding.

The post lists four Ethereum addresses identified as theft addresses: 0x5cf70edce65847ef989933c3072fb0e7f335abc1, 0xe378cdccb369a64a0190577787ef61ca2eefa6b2, 0x3e6c3d135ca8f8be793e5fe1715ce6c057d140f2 and 0x99d314e6970b8d3db0dbe6f6e041cc904143400f.

title_zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  盗窃欧盟实体资金黑客昨日买入27553枚ETH，价值约6283万美元
title_en: 🔍 On-chain Detective | Hacker who stole funds from an EU entity bought 27,553 ETH yesterday, worth about $62.83 million
summary_zh:
据链上分析师 Ai 姨（@ai_9684xtpa）监测，疑似盗走欧盟实体约 1.06 亿美元资金的黑客昨日单日买入 27553 枚 ETH，价值约 6283 万美元，全部建仓均在链上完成，均价约 2280.34 美元；截至 11 月 3 日报道时，其买入行为似乎已经暂停。

在涉案资金正被兑换和转移、而非被冻结的情况下，这笔买入是目前披露出的最具体的一条链上线索，为调查人员和交易平台合规团队提供了可供追踪的新地址集合。

链上侦探 ZachXBT 在其个人频道发文称，某欧盟实体疑似从多个中心化交易平台账户中损失超 1.06 亿美元。黑客持续将大量 USDC 兑换为 ETH，转移至即时交易平台，通过 Wagyu 转换为门罗币（XMR），并跨多条链进行桥接转移。
summary_en:
According to on-chain analyst Ai Yi (@ai_9684xtpa), a hacker suspected of stealing roughly $106 million from an EU entity bought 27,553 ETH in a single day, worth about $62.83 million, with all purchases executed on-chain at an average price of about $2,280.34; buying appears to have paused as of the Nov. 3 report.

The purchase is the largest concrete on-chain trace disclosed so far in a case where the alleged proceeds are being converted and moved rather than frozen, giving investigators and exchange compliance teams a fresh set of addresses to track.

On-chain detective ZachXBT said in a post on his personal channel that an EU entity appeared to have lost more than $106 million from accounts across multiple centralized exchanges. The hacker has been converting large amounts of USDC into ETH, moving funds to an instant exchange service to swap into Monero (XMR) via Wagyu, and bridging across multiple chains.

title_zh: Liquid：比特币储备已全部恢复，LBTC重回1:1支撑
title_en: Liquid: Bitcoin reserves fully restored, LBTC returns to 1:1 backing
summary_zh:
11 月 3 日，Liquid Federation 宣布网络比特币储备已全部恢复，为全部 LBTC 重新确立 1:1 的 BTC 支撑。用户已可通过参与互换的服务商，按 1:1 比例在比特币与 Liquid 之间转移。

此次公告重新确立了此前因储备缺口而受影响的 1:1 锚定关系，使流通中的 LBTC 恢复全额支撑，并重新开放用户按 1:1 进行 BTC 与 Liquid 之间的转移。

据援引 Liquid Federation 的报道，储备可通过节点校验和公共数据面板公开验证。公告未披露缺口规模及补救过程。
summary_en:
On November 3, the Liquid Federation announced that the network's Bitcoin reserves have been fully restored, re-establishing 1:1 BTC backing for all LBTC. Users can again move between bitcoin and Liquid at a 1:1 ratio through participating swap providers.

The announcement re-establishes the 1:1 peg that had been disrupted by a reserve shortfall, restoring full backing for LBTC in circulation and reopening 1:1 BTC↔Liquid transfers for users.

According to reports citing the Federation, the reserves can be publicly verified through node checks and a public dashboard. The announcement did not disclose the size of the shortfall or the remediation process.

title_zh: SEC部门在无异议函中将Canton Coin视为数字商品
title_en: SEC division views Canton Coin as digital commodity in no-action letter
summary_zh:
美国证券交易委员会（SEC）公司金融部于2026年11月3日发布无异议函，表示基于申请方信函中的陈述，其认为Canton Coin属于相关解释文件中所称的“数字商品”。这一工作人员层面的立场意味着，基于该认定，SEC工作人员不会建议采取执法行动。

这封函为Canton Coin提供了针对该资产的监管明确性，将其纳入SEC工作人员所称的“数字商品”范畴。

该认定以申请方信函中的陈述为依据，属于针对Canton Coin的SEC工作人员层面立场，并非委员会规则，也不构成具有约束力的行业统一分类。
summary_en:
The SEC's Division of Corporation Finance issued a no-action letter dated Nov. 3, 2026, stating that, based on representations in the requester's letter, it views Canton Coin as a 'digital commodity' as described in the referenced Interpretation. The staff position indicates it would not recommend enforcement action on that basis.

The letter provides asset-specific regulatory clarity for Canton Coin by placing it within the SEC staff's 'digital commodity' framing.

The view rests on representations in the requester's letter and is a staff-level position specific to Canton Coin, not a Commission rule or a binding industry-wide classification.

title_zh: Tether CEO 称公司持有约 15 万枚比特币
title_en: Tether CEO Says Company Owns Approximately 150,000 Bitcoin
summary_zh:
Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino 在卢加诺 Plan ₿ Forum 的主题演讲中表示，公司持有约 15 万枚比特币，全球用户超过 7.3 亿，每季度新增约 3000 万个钱包。他援引 Tether 2026 年第三季度 attestation（储备证明），其中直接持有的美国短期国债约 1228 亿美元，计入回购协议后约 1324 亿美元，超额储备约 79.5 亿美元。

此番表态公开了这家最大稳定币发行方所持比特币的大致规模，并同时披露了市场参与者用以评估 USDT 储备支撑的储备数据。这是一次主题演讲中的表述，而非新的购买公告或监管申报文件。

上述数据来自 Tether 2026 年第三季度 attestation，这是一份定期的储备鉴证报告，而非对公司财务报表的完整审计。Ardoino 还介绍了 Tether 更广泛的“Independence Stack”计划，涵盖能源、比特币挖矿、点对点通信、自托管钱包和设备端 AI。
summary_en:
Speaking in a keynote at the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano, Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said the company owns approximately 150,000 BTC and serves more than 730 million users, adding about 30 million new wallets per quarter. He cited Tether's Q3 2026 attestation, which showed roughly $122.8 billion in directly held U.S. Treasury bills — $132.4 billion including repurchase agreements — and about $7.95 billion in excess reserves.

The remarks make public the approximate scale of Bitcoin held by the largest stablecoin issuer, alongside reserve figures that market participants track when gauging USDT's backing. It was a keynote statement rather than an announcement of a new purchase or a regulatory filing.

The figures come from Tether's Q3 2026 attestation, a periodic assurance report rather than a full audit of the company's financial statements. Ardoino also described Tether's wider Independence Stack initiative, covering energy, Bitcoin mining, peer-to-peer communications, self-custody wallets and on-device AI.

title_zh: Anthropic 正在研发一套可证明 AI 模型身份的系统
title_en: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
summary_zh:
据 Anthropic 周二发布的一篇博客文章，该公司正在研发一套名为 FlashProve 的开源系统，可让任何人验证某段 AI 输出究竟由哪个模型生成。Anthropic 用 Llama 4 Maverick（一个 4000 亿参数的混合专家模型）在单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上演示了该方案。

该计划针对模型身份伪造与冒名问题，目标是让开发者和平台能够核验某段回复是否确实来自其所声称的模型。

Anthropic 将 FlashProve 描述为一套开源系统，演示中它借助单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 与 Llama 4 Maverick 生成证明。该系统仍处于研发阶段，尚未发布或获得广泛采用的实现。
summary_en:
Anthropic is developing FlashProve, an open source system that would let anyone verify which AI model produced a given output, according to a company blog post published Tuesday. The company demonstrated the approach using Llama 4 Maverick, a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, running on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.

The effort targets model-identity and impersonation concerns, aiming to give developers and platforms a way to check that a response genuinely came from the model it claims to originate from.

Anthropic describes FlashProve as an open source system, and the demo produced proofs on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU with Llama 4 Maverick. The system is still in development, with no shipped or widely adopted implementation yet.

title_zh: 加密项目文档托管平台 GitBook 遭 AI 智能体安全攻击，敦促用户轮换密钥
title_en: Crypto Docs Host GitBook Hit by AI Agent Security Breach, Urges Users to Rotate Keys
summary_zh:
GitBook 披露，一起“使用 AI 智能体的复杂、高度定向攻击”于欧洲中部时间 11 月 2 日晚 7 点未经授权访问了其部分基础设施凭证。这家被加密项目广泛使用的文档平台下线了需登录访问的站点，撤销了个人 API 令牌，并敦促客户更换已连接的凭证。

GitBook 与客户账户及外部服务的连接意味着影响范围波及加密团队的集成令牌、Git Sync 密钥和 API 令牌。PancakeSwap 的回应是先暂时下线其文档，随后将其迁出该平台，同时表示自身系统并未被入侵。

GitBook 表示调查未发现托管内容被篡改的证据，可能暴露的数据包括集成令牌、Git Sync 密钥、API 令牌以及提交给其 AI 助手的问题。公司称截至周二下午其应用、API 和已发布文档已恢复访问，但部分服务在恢复期间仍可能降级；它尚未解释攻击者如何使用这些 AI 工具、涉及哪些 AI 系统，以及凭证是如何被获取的。
summary_en:
GitBook disclosed that a "sophisticated, highly targeted attack using AI agents" gained unauthorized access to some of its infrastructure credentials at 7 p.m. Central European Time on November 2. The documentation platform, widely used by crypto projects, took authentication-gated sites offline, revoked personal API tokens and urged customers to replace connected credentials.

GitBook's connections to customer accounts and external services mean the blast radius extends to crypto teams' integration tokens, Git Sync secrets and API tokens. PancakeSwap responded by temporarily taking its documentation offline before moving it off the platform, while saying its own systems were not compromised.

GitBook said its investigation found no evidence that hosted content was modified, and that potentially exposed data includes integration tokens, Git Sync secrets, API tokens and questions submitted to its AI assistant. By Tuesday afternoon the company said its application, API and published documentation were accessible again, though some services could remain degraded; it has not explained how the attacker used the AI tools, which AI systems were involved, or how the credentials were obtained.

title_zh: 我笔记本电脑上的 Qwen 3.8 27B 也能解读模型权重
title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
summary_zh:
Simon Willison 报告称，他在自己笔记本电脑上本地运行的 Qwen 3.8 27B 能够解读原始模型权重，复现了 Rikiya Takehi、Jayden Teoh、Alex Zhang 与 Omar Khattab 合著的论文《Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights》中的一个示例。该论文此前是以 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型展示这一能力的。

这一演示表明，无需工具即可读取权重的能力并不局限于 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿系统——一个在笔记本上运行的开放权重模型复现了论文中的一个示例。不过它仍属于探索性的博客复现，而非正式成果或同行评审结论。

论文的第一个实验训练了四个神经网络，让它们玩 10x10 网格版的 Breakout、Pong、Pac-Man 和 Freeway，随后把权重以浮点数形式交给大模型，并说明模型没有工具、不能执行代码、只有一次回答机会，要求其判断每个网络是为哪款游戏训练的。Willison 聚焦于这个“无工具”问题，并提到批评者 Matthew Honnibal 与 Sean Goedecke 对论文将借助代码编辑模型的做法归入同一概念提出质疑。
summary_en:
Simon Willison reported that Qwen 3.8 27B, running locally on his laptop, could interpret raw model weights in a replication of an example from the paper "Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights" by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang and Omar Khattab. That paper had demonstrated the capability with frontier models, specifically GPT-6 Astra.

The demonstration indicates that no-tools weight reading is not confined to frontier systems such as GPT-6 Astra, since an open-weight model running on a laptop reproduced one of the paper's examples. It remains an exploratory blog-post replication rather than a formal result or peer-reviewed finding.

The paper's first experiment trained four neural networks to play 10x10 grid versions of Breakout, Pong, Pac-Man and Freeway, then supplied the weights as floating-point numbers to an LLM with the instruction that it had no tools, no code execution and a single response to identify which game each network was trained on. Willison focused on this no-tools question, noting that critics Matthew Honnibal and Sean Goedecke disputed the paper's framing of code-assisted model editing.

title_zh: 币安64亿美元黑客事件后，Coinbase强调其分片密钥冷存储设计
title_en: Coinbase Cites Split-Key Cold Storage After Binance $6.4B Hack
summary_zh:
在币安据报遭遇64亿美元黑客攻击后，Coinbase强调其分片密钥（split-key）冷存储架构，并表示99%的客户资产存放于冷存储之中。该表态被置于行业重新审视托管安全与密钥管理的背景下。

这一表态把焦点引向交易所如何设计密钥管理架构，而这一点正是客户与交易对手评估大型平台托管风险的核心。

各方报道对事件规模表述不一，有63亿美元与64亿美元两种说法。币安自身的初步调查称，10月29日事件影响约63.4亿美元数字资产，截至10月31日已有98%的受影响代币得到补充，并可在其储备证明页面核验。
summary_en:
In the wake of a reported $6.4 billion hack at Binance, Coinbase pointed to its split-key cold storage design and stated that 99% of customer assets are held in cold storage. The disclosure was framed as the industry re-examines custody security and key management.

The remarks shift attention to how exchanges architect key management, which is central to how customers and counterparties gauge custodial risk at a major venue.

Reports on the incident differ on magnitude, describing a $6.3 billion or $6.4 billion breach. Binance's own initial findings said about $6.34 billion of digital assets were affected in the Oct. 29 incident and that 98% of the impacted tokens had been replenished as of Oct. 31, verifiable on its proof-of-reserves page.

title_zh: Riot 签署 280 亿美元 AI 租约，覆盖整个 Corsicana 园区
title_en: Riot Signs $28 Billion AI Lease for Entire Corsicana Campus
summary_zh:
Riot Platforms 签署了一份为期 15 年的数据中心租约，覆盖其位于德克萨斯州 Corsicana 园区的全部 910 兆瓦关键 IT 容量，合同总价值约 280 亿美元，计入上调条款后的年均租金约 18 亿美元。公司在季报文件中披露租户为 Anthropic，该租户将自有关并运营计算设备，而 Riot 提供原本为比特币挖矿开发的土地与电力基础设施。

该交易使 Riot 今年签署的三份租约累计合同容量达到 1,151 兆瓦，长期合同收入约 380 亿美元。首席执行官 Jason Les 表示，在目前已签约项目全部部署后，公司预期现金流几乎全部来自与 AI 企业的长期租约，而非比特币挖矿；消息公布后公司股价上涨逾 13%。

Riot 预计项目总资本开支为 55 亿美元，主要将通过以租约为担保的债务融资，但该融资尚未落实。首期预计于 2027 年 9 月交付，租金在交付后 60 天内开始支付；Les 称 Corsicana 的比特币挖矿可能在 2027 年夏季开始逐步退出。第三季度 Riot 卖出 10,599 枚 BTC，持仓从 6 月底的 11,380 枚降至 9 月底的 2,418 枚；前九个月累计卖出 20,264 枚 BTC，套现约 15 亿美元。
summary_en:
Riot Platforms signed a 15-year data center lease covering the entirety of its Corsicana, Texas campus — 910 MW of critical IT capacity — at roughly $28 billion in total contract value and about $1.8 billion in average annual rent including escalators. The tenant, identified as Anthropic in the company's quarterly filing, will own and operate the computing equipment while Riot supplies land and power infrastructure originally developed for Bitcoin mining.

The deal lifts Riot's total contracted data center capacity to 1,151 MW and about $38 billion in long-term contract revenue across three leases signed this year. CEO Jason Les said that at full deployment of currently executed deals, nearly all of Riot's expected cash flow will come from long-term leases with AI players rather than from Bitcoin mining, and the shares rose more than 13% on the announcement.

Riot estimates total project capital costs at $5.5 billion, to be financed primarily through debt backed by lease payments, though that financing has not yet been secured. First-phase delivery is expected in September 2027 with rent payments starting within 60 days of delivery, and Les said Bitcoin mining at Corsicana could begin winding down in summer 2027. In the third quarter Riot sold 10,599 BTC, cutting holdings from 11,380 at end-June to 2,418 at end-September, and it sold 20,264 BTC over the first nine months for about $1.5 billion.

title_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 确认遭网络攻击，此前 ZachXBT 将其与 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案关联
title_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
summary_zh:
法国银行集团 Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 周三向 Decrypt 发表声明，确认其遭遇了一次使欺诈性操作得以进行的网络攻击，称事件已“关闭并处于控制之下”，业务正在逐步恢复。这一确认出现在链上调查员 ZachXBT 公开指认该行为超过 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案疑似受害方的次日。

该行表示在发现攻击后立即通报了相关监管机构，并作为预防措施暂停了部分交易。ZachXBT 则指责该机构未进行“适当的事件披露”，称这导致执法部门无法冻结约 3000 万美元被盗资金。

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 未提及加密货币，也未说明被盗金额，称受影响金额仍在评估中，但“无论如何都不足以动摇集团的稳健性与财务健康”；该行称客户资产未受影响，只是部分转账执行被延迟。ZachXBT 最初指出 11 月 1 日有逾 1.06 亿美元从交易所账户被提走，随后追加 2700 万美元，并公布了四个以太坊地址，还表示可以“高度确信”攻击者并非 Lazarus 组织。
summary_en:
French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed in a statement to Decrypt on Wednesday that it was hit by a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent operations, saying the incident is "closed and now under control" and that operations are resuming gradually. The confirmation came one day after onchain investigator ZachXBT publicly named the bank as the alleged victim of a crypto theft exceeding $133 million.

The bank said it alerted the relevant supervisory authorities as soon as it detected the attack and temporarily suspended some transactions as a precaution. ZachXBT accused the institution of failing to make a "proper incident disclosure," which he said prevented law enforcement from freezing some $30 million in stolen funds.

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa did not mention crypto or state how much was taken, saying the affected amounts are still being assessed but are "in any event not of a nature to call into question the solidity and financial health of the group"; it said customer assets were unaffected and some transfers were only delayed. ZachXBT initially flagged more than $106 million in withdrawals from exchange accounts on November 1, later added $27 million, published four Ethereum addresses, and said he could state "with a high degree of confidence" the attacker is not the Lazarus Group.

title_zh: BitMart创始人称新一起黑客攻击后安全团队“严重人手不足”
title_en: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
summary_zh:
BitMart证实周一发生了一起新的黑客攻击，创始人Sheldon Xia周三在X上发文称，重组之后该交易所的安全团队“目前严重人手不足”。Xia称涉案金额不大，但未披露具体数字；区块链分析公司Bitquery则在调查中识别出约39.1万美元的可疑转账，涉及三条区块链上主要与BitMart相关的钱包。

Bitquery将这些资金追溯到一个同样涉及11月2日（周一）Mercado Bitcoin逾4600万美元黑客事件的钱包，这支持了Xia关于两起事件可能存在关联的初步怀疑。

Xia表示，针对员工的威胁以及前员工所称的报复行为，使留住技术人员的工作变得复杂。Cointelegraph称已就重组、安全团队人员配置及最新攻击事件联系BitMart，但截至发稿未获回复。
summary_en:
BitMart confirmed a new hack on Monday, and founder Sheldon Xia said in a post on X on Wednesday that the exchange's security team is "currently severely understaffed" following restructuring. Xia described the amount involved as small without disclosing a figure, while blockchain analytics firm Bitquery identified approximately $391,000 in suspicious transfers from wallets mostly associated with BitMart across three blockchains.

Bitquery traced the funds to a wallet also implicated in the more than $46 million Mercado Bitcoin hack on Monday, Nov. 2, supporting Xia's preliminary suspicion of a possible connection between the two incidents.

Xia said threats against employees and alleged retaliation by former staff had complicated efforts to retain technical personnel. Cointelegraph said it had contacted BitMart for details on the restructuring, security staffing and the latest breach but had not received a response by publication.

title_zh: 众议院易主改变加密立法走向，弗兰奇·希尔的选战仍难分胜负
title_en: French Hill's race still too close to call as House flips, changing the direction of crypto legislation
summary_zh:
据 The Block 报道，2026 年中期选举后美国众议院的控制权已经易主，而众议员弗兰奇·希尔（French Hill）的选战仍难分胜负。众议院归属的变化将改变国会在加密立法上的走向。

多数党更替意味着主导数字资产法案的委员会主席职位将转由另一党掌握，从而改变哪些市场结构提案能够推进以及以何种形式推进。

众议院的整体结果已经确定，但希尔本人的选战尚未宣布结果，这使得一位在加密政策上颇具影响力的共和党人物能否留任仍存变数。
summary_en:
The Block reports that control of the U.S. House of Representatives has flipped in the 2026 midterm elections, while the race of Rep. French Hill remains too close to call. The chamber outcome changes the direction of crypto legislation in Congress.

A change of majority hands the committee gavels that shape digital-asset bills to the other party, altering which market-structure proposals can advance and in what form.

The House outcome has been called, but Hill's own race remains uncalled, leaving the identity of a prominent Republican voice on crypto policy unsettled.

title_zh: Strategy 融资 54 亿美元，却几乎没买比特币
title_en: Strategy raises $5.4B but barely buys bitcoin
summary_zh:
Strategy 在 7 月至 9 月期间通过按市价（ATM）增发普通股融资 54 亿美元，但其中仅 5.88 亿美元用于购买比特币，相当于每融资 1 美元投入比特币不足 11 美分。公司同期还卖出 5,552 枚自有比特币，套现 3.486 亿美元，部分用于支付股息，部分用于回购其 STRC 优先股。

这一披露打破了此前的模式：2024 年几乎每一美元 ATM 融资都变成了比特币，即便在表现异常的 2025 年第三季度，每 1 美元中仍有逾 94 美分用于买入比特币。其意义在于，Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币储备公司，其融资中最终流向现货比特币购买的比例，是一条可直接观察的需求渠道。

Strategy 当季共买入 7,218 枚比特币，扣除卖出部分后，净持仓仅比季初增加 1,666 枚。在 10 月 26 日当周的披露中，新增 1.64 亿美元 MSTR 增发，每 1 美元中仅 40 美分用于购买比特币。
summary_en:
Strategy raised $5.4 billion through at-the-market common stock sales between July and September but spent only $588 million of that on bitcoin — less than 11 cents of every dollar raised. The company also sold 5,552 of its own BTC for $348.6 million, partly to fund dividends and partly to repurchase its STRC preferred stock.

The disclosure breaks a pattern: in 2024 essentially every ATM dollar became bitcoin, and even in the anomalous third quarter of 2025 more than 94 cents of each dollar still bought BTC. The shift matters because Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin treasury, so the share of its fundraising that reaches spot BTC purchases is a directly observable demand channel.

Strategy bought 7,218 BTC during the quarter and, after accounting for its sales, ended with just 1,666 more coins than it started with. In the reporting week of October 26, $164 million of fresh MSTR dilution saw only 40 cents of each dollar go toward BTC.
